candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout; the gateway's own latency is low (p95 ~325ms, responses 16-110ms), so the failure originates in the order dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db-pool, payment, inventory) not established; order-side logs/traces and dependency metrics unavailable.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order POST /v1/orders returning 500 across all correlated requests; gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout with low latency, and topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Bounded candidate is http-500 at order; deeper cause requires order-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the 500 responses to identify the failing internal dependency
Order dependency operation metrics (payment, inventory, postgresql) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
Excluded gateway logs (ev-f430679fd864ea83-r0-gw_logs) to confirm error propagation
